verdict.rationale: The M&A page documents buy/sell-side deals for private and public listed companies, and the Private Equity page explicitly covers 'exit strategies and implementation,' giving some through-exit coverage. However, there is no dedicated capital-markets/IPO practice page or public-offering credentials, and no case studies framed specifically around venture-backed companies reaching exit. Missing for 10: an explicit IPO/capital-markets practice page, and venture-backed-specific exit/IPO case studies or track record.
